name: esko-webcenter-mcp
description: Read-only MCP server for Esko WebCenter (Claude Desktop extension)

scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=server/index.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);" && esbuild src/http.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=server/http.js --banner:js="import{createRequire}from'module';const require=createRequire(import.meta.url);"
